links.outcome: Readability of AI chatbot responses to inherited pediatric orthopaedic queries versus recommended 8th-grade level
links.effect: AI outputs averaged FRE 36.1 and FKGL 12.3; only 6 of 304 (2%) AI outputs were at or below eighth-grade level.
links.quote: Only six of 304 (2%) AI outputs had a readability score at or below the eighth-grade reading level, with five (83%) being generated by ChatGPT4o and one from the Google AI Summary generated alongside search results.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of online patient education websites versus recommended 6th-8th grade
links.effect: Websites averaged FRE 38.2 and FKGL 12.1; only 64 (18.0%) at or below eighth-grade level.
links.quote: There were 64 websites (18.0%) with FKGL scores at or below the eighth-grade reading level (FKGL ≤8.9).

links.outcome: Change in LLM output readability when prompts requested simpler language
links.effect: Readability-request prompts lowered output to average FRE 69.0 and FKGL 6.8, versus FKGL 12.3 without such request; all models reached 6th-7th grade.
links.quote: The average FRE and FKGL across all model outputs was 69.0 and 6.8, respectively ( Table 4 ).
